Its main finding is that safe restart remains materially underspecified for partial copies and crashes between filesystem and database updates; SQLite transactions do not make those separate operations atomic ([SQLite transaction docs](https://www.sqlite.org/lang_transaction.html), [atomic commit](https://www.sqlite.org/atomiccommit.html)). No implementation or collection validation was run.
